title: ai_pr_report sources
description: Selects which GitHub orgs / GitLab groups and repositories ai_pr_report.py scans. Wildcards: '*' matches within one path segment, '**' also across '/', '?' matches one character. Matching is case-insensitive and against the whole name.

since.description: Only PRs/MRs created on or after this date, or 'all'. Default: 12 months ago.

orgs.description: GitHub organizations to scan. Literal names are used as-is; wildcards are matched against the orgs you belong to.

repos.description: Repository filter. A pattern without '/' matches the bare repo name; with '/' it matches 'org/repo'.

groups.description: GitLab group paths to scan (e.g. 'my-group' or 'my-group/sub'). Literal paths are used as-is; wildcards are matched against the groups you can access (needs a token that can list groups).

repos.description: Project filter. A pattern without '/' matches the bare project name; with '/' it matches the full path 'group/sub/project'.

include.description: Names or wildcards to process. Empty or missing means everything.

exclude.description: Names or wildcards to skip. Exclude always wins over include.
